items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: They had Phil Woods, Coleman Hawkins, Rouse, I forget his first -- Charlie Rouse, and Bennie Carter, and I forget the others. Five saxophones. So it was all like supersax, you know. Now, this was in the sixties, you know.

ctx.x: Yeah. Beautiful number. And they featured Phil Woods And Phil did a tremendous job on it. Okay? He's a modernist. So I was in New York in later years and Benny Carter was there to do some recording, so he called me to do this recording with him. Good. Now, I guess this was another -- this was a little before supersax, because Benny had the same idea. There was all saxophone. There was a rhythm section and saxophone. They had Phil Woods, Coleman Hawkins, Rouse, I forget his first -- Charlie Rouse, and Bennie…
They weren't doing someone's solos, though
